description: Rewrite the Feature-list synchronization Claude Skill and portable Prompt as paired English canonical instructions. Synchronization must preserve the configured document language and completed history while recording revisions in the same language as durable project knowledge.
acceptance_criteria: Both synchronization workflows use natural English canonical instructions
New and revised natural-language Feature values follow document_language
Existing completed history is not translated or rewritten solely because of the migration
Native and portable variants preserve equivalent diff revision and consistency behavior
notes: Human acceptance passed on 2026-08-26. Feature-list synchronization now uses canonical English instructions across paired Claude Skill and portable Prompt distributions. New and revised durable Feature and revision prose follows document_language, while conversation language remains transient and completed history is not translated or substantively rewritten. All seven stages, anchor and diff behavior, status transitions, legitimate completed-history exceptions, revision schema, validation, commit, exception, and Git boundaries are preserved. Automated verification: all 35 repository tests passed; the native and portable workflow bodies are byte-for-byte equivalent below their canonical heading; JSON validation and git diff checks passed.
